annotations.title: Cancel a calendar event already sent

description:
Cancel a calendar event this number already sent.

The event stays in the chat marked as canceled, and WhatsApp tells the
guests. Send the same `name` and `start_at` the event has, plus the
details you want the canceled card to still show (`description`,
`end_at`, `join_link`, `location`, `has_reminder` with
`reminder_offset_sec`, `extra_guests_allowed`): the canceled event is
shown with what you send here, and anything you leave out disappears
from it.

Cancel when the date, time or place change and the guests must accept
again: cancel the old event here, then send the new one with
`send_calendar_event`, because the old answer does not carry over to a
new event. To correct a mistake (a typo, the description, a link) use
`edit_calendar_event` instead, and the guests keep their answer. A
cancel does not change the entry a guest already added to their own
calendar with the card's "Add to calendar" button. It stays on the old
date, and adding again creates a second entry, which only the guest can
delete.

Only a calendar event can be canceled. Using this tool on any other
message answers `invalid_request: message_not_editable`; to take back a
message of another kind, use `delete_message`.

Only a message sent THROUGH Turbo Notify can be canceled. One typed on
the phone itself belongs to the same number but cannot be canceled
here, and neither can a message received from someone else.

The 15-minute limit for a text or a caption does not apply to a calendar
event.

The cancel is accepted at once and the outcome arrives as an event:
`message.edited` when it worked, `message.edit.failed` when WhatsApp or
the platform could not apply it. Read them with `list_events`.

The number first appears online and its unread messages in that
conversation are marked as read, then the cancel happens. Opening
the conversation this way is automatic and uses no quota of its own.

EventLocation.description: Where a calendar event takes place: a map pin with an optional name and address.

address.description: The place's address, up to 500 characters.
address.title: Address

name.description: A name for the place, up to 200 characters.
name.title: Name

url.description: A link shown beside the pin.
url.title: Url

EventLocation.title: EventLocation

description.description: Details shown on the event, up to 2000 characters.
description.title: Description

end_at.description: When the event ends. ISO 8601 with an offset, and later than `start_at`.
end_at.title: End At

extra_guests_allowed.description: Set to true to let guests bring extra people. Off when left out.
extra_guests_allowed.title: Extra Guests Allowed

has_reminder.description: Set to true to remind guests before the event. Off when left out.
has_reminder.title: Has Reminder

join_link.description: A link guests can open to join, for example a video call.
join_link.title: Join Link

location.description: Where the event takes place: a map pin with an optional name and address.

message_id.description: Message id (`msg_…`), as returned by a send or by `list_messages`.
message_id.title: Message Id

name.description: The event's title, up to 200 characters.
name.title: Name

number_alias.description: Which of the organization's WhatsApp numbers this acts on: `main`, the alias of an extra number, or the number's `id` (`num_…`), which stays the same when the alias is renamed. Call `list_numbers` to see them. Defaults to the main number.
number_alias.title: Number Alias

reminder_offset_sec.description: How many seconds before the event the reminder goes off, for example 600 for ten minutes. Only takes effect together with `has_reminder`.
reminder_offset_sec.title: Reminder Offset Sec

start_at.description: When the event starts. ISO 8601 with an offset, for example `2026-09-10T14:00:00Z`. A time without an offset is rejected.
start_at.title: Start At
